## TemplateManager.\_readTemplateFile() method

Reads a template file's content from disk.

**Signature:**

```typescript
_readTemplateFile(filename: string): string | null;
```

## Parameters

<table><thead><tr><th>

</th><th>

**Returns:**

string \| null

Template content string, or `null` if not found

## Remarks

If no extension is provided, tries `.ts`<!-- -->, `.js`<!-- -->, then `.html` in order. Searches all configured paths until a match is found.

## Example


```typescript
this._readTemplateFile("welcome")
// => "<base>...</base>"
```
